name: Hunter Valley Golf Club
why: OSM has the course at Lovedale only as an unnamed, partial boundary (39 ha). Its 18 hole lines were remapped after 2026-09-27 (way/1544913558-75); holes 7 and 9 run 11% and 15% outside the boundary, and no other course is near, so lines 80% inside count. No card in the source: the course page checks the NAS card live.
